title: fix(platform-objects): offer Unlock Account and Set Password without the better-auth admin plugin
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi95Ria7nkoYHNufdhAbPptHq)_

Fixes #34010
Fixes #34130
Waits-on: #34119 (merged as 41ff7c34; this branch merged `origin/main` in round 3)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Setup → 用户里的「解锁账号」（`unlock_user`）和「设置密码」（`set_user_password`）去掉了 `requiresFeature: 'admin'`。没开 better-auth admin 插件的环境现在也会显示这两个按钮：解锁对被锁定的账号显示（自托管默认、托管的 Free/Team 环境都适用）；设置密码只在非托管环境显示，托管环境仍按原规则隐藏。规格里 admin 特性的门禁登记表同步去掉这两项；`features.admin` 的说明文字、插件列表注释和认证文档里「这些操作需要 admin 插件」的旧说法一并改正（只有建用户、批量导入用户真正需要插件）。
- 为什么改：实测证明两个接口都不依赖 admin 插件。插件关时，连续输错密码锁住的账号，经管理员调用 `admin/unlock-user` 后锁定清除、可正常登录；管理员调用 `admin/set-user-password` 返回 200，成员可用新密码登录、旧密码失效；非管理员调用都被 403 拒绝。但按钮仍要求 admin 插件才显示，管理员在这些环境里无法在界面上解锁或重设密码。
- 风险与回滚：只改显示条件，接口、权限（`requiredPermissions`）、平台管理员身份判断，以及解锁「有锁定或开了两步验证才显示」、设置密码「托管环境隐藏」的规则都不变；建用户、模拟登录仍保持 admin 插件门控。回滚即还原这一个 PR。
- 先看：`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`（两处删除与块头注释）、`packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts`（登记表去掉两项）、`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/pending-sso-users.test.ts`（两组新的实跑钉子）、`content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx`（标题与路由说明）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/pending-sso-users.test.ts -t "34010|34130"`，预期 7 个用例全绿（解锁：未托管、托管各一次实跑加插件开对照；设置密码：未托管实跑、按对话框默认值实跑、托管仍隐藏、插件开对照）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `sys_user.unlock_user` drops `requiresFeature: 'admin'`. Its `visible` predicate (the platform-admin standing, then a row with a lock stamp or two-factor enabled) and `requiredPermissions` are unchanged.
- #34130 (round 2): `sys_user.set_user_password` drops `requiresFeature: 'admin'` too. Its `visible` (the platform-admin standing and `features.cloudManaged != true`) and `requiredPermissions` are unchanged, so it stays hidden on a cloud-managed environment, whose door refuses every target. The card also asked to keep it hidden "for non-local accounts, as today": the predicate carries no identity-source rule today, so there is none to keep; the door's own refusals (a pending person `409`, SSO-only mode) are unchanged.
- `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES.admin.gatedInputs` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts`) no longer books `sys_user.actions.unlock_user` or `sys_user.actions.set_user_password`; `admin` keeps `create_user` and `impersonate_user`. Forced, as on #33989: `feature-gate-guard.test.ts` holds the registry and the lowered predicates in lockstep, and its forward walk reds a booked input without the gate (seen in the ablation below).
- The admin block header in `sys-user.object.ts`, record 6897296837's nits:
  - N1: the "buttons that 404" rationale no longer names `unlock_user`. It now names the two actions that keep the gate (`create_user`, `impersonate_user`), and the Ban / Unban paragraph becomes Ban / Unban / Unlock / Set Password, with the measured reasons (the lockout is plugin-auth's own, ADR-0069 D2, and the unlock clears it through the data engine; the password is written through better-auth's core `internalAdapter`).
  - N2: an expired `banned` is cleared at the next sign-in by better-auth's admin plugin where it is mounted, and by plugin-auth's `user-session-admission.ts` where it is not. The orphaned quote N2 named in `sys-user-set-manager-action.test.ts` ("only wired when `auth.plugins.admin` is enabled") is reworded to what the header says now.
- Round 3 (after #34119 merged), the stale "needs the admin plugin" copies, record 6902922670's nits:
  - `features.admin` describe (`packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.zod.ts`, `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema`): its second sentence said the console still shows unlock and set-password only when the flag is true. It now says banning, unbanning, unlocking and setting a password answer without the plugin, and whether the console offers those actions does not depend on the flag. `content/docs/references/api/auth-endpoints.mdx` regenerated (`check:generated --fix`).
  - `plugins.admin` describe (`packages/spec/src/system/auth-config.zod.ts`): read against main, it carries no console-button sentence (it already says ban/unban, unlock and set-password are served without the plugin), so it is unchanged.
  - `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-plugin-list.ts`: comment only. It booked ban/unban and set-password on the vendor admin plugin; it now names what the plugin carries (what create-user and import-users drive, impersonation, better-auth's own `/admin/*` routes) and says ban/unban, unlock and set-password are ObjectStack mounts served with or without it.
  - `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx`: the "Admin User Management (requires `plugins.admin`; …)" heading becomes "Admin User Management (platform-admin gated)"; its exceptions line now says `create-user` and `import-users` need `plugins.admin` (`501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` without it, `admin-user-endpoints.ts` / `admin-import-users.ts`) and `set-user-password`, `unlock-user`, `ban-user`, `unban-user`, `add-sso-user`, `import-sso-users` answer with or without it; the earlier paragraph no longer puts Set Password behind `plugins: { admin: true }`.
  - N1: the `set_user_password` `visible` comment no longer says the server keeps answering on an `env_native` row; it says the door refuses every target on a cloud-managed environment (`cloud-managed.ts`).
  - N2: `34010-unlock-without-admin-plugin.md` and this body carry plain `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none`.
  - N4: a new pin drives Set Password with the dialog's declared defaults (`mustChangePassword: true`, `revokeSessionsAndKeys: true`) on a kernel without the plugin (below).
  - N5: the `actions.mdx` `ban_user` example was already replaced on main by #34119 (it now shows `impersonate_user`); nothing to change here.
  - N3, measured fact, not changed here (the seat files it): in SSO-only mode `set_user_password` is offered on an `idp_provisioned` row, but the door refuses that target (`admin-user-endpoints.ts`, the `judgeSsoOnlyLocalPassword` check around line 1171). Read from code: the action's `visible` carries no identity-source term and the door does; no run here exercised SSO-only mode.
- Root changesets, one per card: `34010-unlock-without-admin-plugin.md` and `34130-set-password-without-admin-plugin.md`, each `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch and `@objectstack/spec` patch, each carrying `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none`. The 34130 note also records the `features.admin` describe correction.

## Why (measured first)

The card asked whether `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/unlock-user` unlocks a locked user end to end with the better-auth admin plugin off. Measured at 8ec7d2c7 (the live pin below, gate still in place), on a real `AuthManager` behind `AuthPlugin.registerAuthRoutes` with `plugins.admin: false` and `lockoutThreshold: 3`, unmanaged and managed:

- three wrong passwords through the real `/sign-in/email` stamp `sys_user.locked_until` in the future, and the right password is then refused `401` with no new session;
- the declared action's `visible` evaluated under the features that kernel serves (`features.admin === false`) answers `false`: hidden (`expected false to be true` at the offer, 2 failed);
- with that one assertion removed for a measure-only run (restored from HEAD afterwards, `git diff HEAD` empty), the rest passed for both kernels (3 passed): a caller without the standing gets `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` and the lock stays; the platform admin posting what the action posts (`userId` from `recordIdParam`) gets `200`, `locked_until` reads null, `failed_login_count` 0; the next sign-in with the right password is `200`.

So the door works without the plugin, and only the offer was missing. Regrade note for the seat: by the triage comment's own rule (p2 if it works without the plugin, same reach as #33759), this measured as p2.

Round 2, #34130, measured at 25f44ac0 (its live pin, gate still in place), `plugins.admin: false`: on an unmanaged kernel the declared `set_user_password` is hidden (`expected false to be true` at the offer, 1 failed, 2 passed). With that assertion removed for a measure-only run (restored from HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty), 3 passed: a caller without the standing gets `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` and the new password does not sign in; the platform admin posting what the action posts (its `bodyExtra`, `userId`, `newPassword`, `mustChangePassword: false`, `revokeSessionsAndKeys: false`) gets `200`; the member then signs in with the new password (`200`) and not with the old one (`401`). On a managed kernel the action stays hidden by its `cloudManaged` rule.

### Clause-② reading

Same reading as record 6897296837 gave #33989 (its N4: "the answer is `no`"). No door or accepted input moves: `admin/unlock-user` was already mounted unconditionally (`auth-plugin.ts`, read only; it is held by #34050 and this PR does not touch it), and nothing server-side reads `visible`. `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES` keeps its name and entry shape; `admin.gatedInputs` loses one string, so its `as const` tuple loses one member. Readers of `gatedInputs` are the same two tests #33989 listed. `check:api-surface` and `check:generated` are green.

## Tests

- `plugin-auth/src/pending-sso-users.test.ts`, new top-level describe `[#34010] Unlock is offered and works without the admin plugin` in the existing shared harness: for an unmanaged and a managed kernel with `plugins.admin: false`, lock the member through the sign-in lockout, show the lock holding, judge the DECLARED `unlock_user` offered under `getPublicConfig().features`, show the door refusing a caller without the standing, post the action's call as the platform admin, read the row cleared and sign in. CONTROL: with the plugin on, the same flow is offered and works.
  - Harness edits: `stage()` takes an optional `config` merged into the manager (for `lockoutThreshold`); the #33759 describe's `ADMIN_PRINCIPAL` / `declaredAction` / `offeredOn` / `actionCall` move to module scope unchanged so both describes share them.
- `plugin-auth/src/pending-sso-users.test.ts`, round 2, new top-level describe `[#34130] Set Password is offered and works without the admin plugin`: unmanaged, `plugins.admin: false`: the DECLARED action is offered, a caller without the standing is refused `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, the admin's call answers `200`, and the member signs in with the new password and not the old; managed: it stays hidden (its `cloudManaged` rule); CONTROL: with the plugin on it is offered and sets the password. The shared `actionCall` now also sends the action's constant `bodyExtra`, as the console does (ban / unban / unlock declare none).
  - Round 3 (N4): `unmanaged kernel: with the dialog defaults the door also flags the member and revokes their sessions`. It reads the declared params' defaults (asserted to be exactly `mustChangePassword: true`, `revokeSessionsAndKeys: true`), posts them with the new password as the admin, and reads `200` with `data.mustChangePassword` and `data.revokeSessionsAndKeys` true and `revoked.complete` true, `sys_user.must_change_password` true, every member `sys_session` row stamped `revoke_reason: admin_password_reset` and expired (count equal to `revoked.sessions`), and the new password signing in.
- `platform-objects/src/identity/action-state-visibility.test.ts`: the #33759 describe becomes `sys_user Ban / Unban / Unlock / Set Password are offered without the admin plugin`, with an Unlock case (a locked or two-factor row offered, one with neither not, managed or not), a Set Password case (offered unmanaged, hidden managed) and the standing leg for both.
- Forced test edits:
  - `action-state-visibility.test.ts`: `unlock_user` and `set_user_password` leave the CONTROL roster `PLUGIN_ONLY` (exactly `create_user` and `impersonate_user` still read `features.admin`).
  - `platform-objects.test.ts`: the `feature-gate-lowering matrix (#2874)` rows for `unlock_user` and `set_user_password` now pin the bare predicates.
  - `identity/cloud-managed-visibility.test.ts`: its "keeps its other flag" case now runs over the five doors that carry another flag; `set_user_password` gets its own case (offered with `admin` off and `cloudManaged` off, hidden with `cloudManaged` on), and the header says why.
  - `sys-user-set-manager-action.test.ts`: comment only (N2's orphaned quote).

## Acceptance notes

- #34119 merged (41ff7c34); round 3 merged `origin/main` (029cfa72) and then made the describe, comment and doc corrections above, as the claim amendment 6903911896 widened the file surface.
- The scope-addition comment 6900996719 on #34130: all three stale copies it named (the `sys-user.object.ts` block header, the `auth-manager-plugin-list.ts` comment, the `authentication.mdx` heading) are corrected here; its N4 (no committed test drives `unlock-user` or `set-user-password` with `plugins.admin` off) is met by the live pins.
- Not touched: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts` (held by #34050); `ui/**`.
